svg.aria-label: Boundary families: candidate prefix and alternative exits
svg.title: Boundary families: candidate prefix and alternative exits
svg.desc: Optional-looking catalogue used for the core range/contraction comparison. Each panel holds its prefix fixed and supplies two later branches. Horizontal references are deliberately declared teaching simplifications, not silently projected sloping detectors.
svg.text: Same six-point range precedes the alternative closes.
Selected ranges narrow; these teaching crossings use the final 48/46 reference values.
Horizontal selected highs 50 and rising troughs 44, 46, 48.
Crossing continuation is downward here; upper 46/lower 44 are final selected references.
Advance then a short broad parallel pause; the example crossing is above final consolidation high 49.5.
Advance then converging selected swings; boundaries are declared final example references.
